name: All Star Bulk Order Block
description: All Star Embroidery Gutenberg bulk-order workflow with WooCommerce and ASE Supplier Sync compatibility.
changelog:
1.1.6

  • Adds a Starting at unit price to collapsed product rows.
  • Adds a gold border and checkmark to the selected decoration method.
  • Adds instant subcategory filtering scoped only to the WooCommerce parent category configured for the ASBO block.
  • Unrelated catalog categories are never shown in the scoped filter.
  • No pricing calculations, supplier-cost logic, cart rules, or checkout behavior changed.
